g.text: Sensor delivery: ISR, worker, retained data, consumer
OV3 · Representative interrupt-driven NuttX sensor path · not the PX4 uORB implementation
The upper half and ring are NOT a broker thread. A wakeup carries no sample; the consumer later copies retained records.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
